_readme: Ready-to-use ZeroScript config for Termux on Android. No MCP, no Roblox.
Copy it over config.json:   cp config.termux.json config.json
It gives the AI read/write access to ONE folder: ~/zs (created by
start-termux.sh). Change {path} defaults or add tools as you like.
To reach your real phone storage, run `termux-setup-storage` once, then
Every 'run' is an argv LIST executed WITHOUT a shell, so an argument can
never start a second command. See NO-MCP.md.
screenshot: needs the Termux:API APP (F-Droid) plus `pkg install termux-api`.
The image is only useful if the model can SEE images - on DeepSeek that
means selecting the Vision tab before starting the agent.

target.name: my phone
target.offline_hint: Make sure the bridge is running in Termux (bash start-termux.sh).

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files in a folder inside the workspace. Use '.' for the top level.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Show the full contents of a text file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file with the given content.

content.description: the full text to put in the file

tools.name: append_file
tools.description: Append a line of text to the end of a file.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search for a text pattern in the workspace and show matching lines with line numbers.

path.description: folder or file to search; defaults to everything

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete ONE file. Destructive - confirm with the user first.

tools.name: phone_status
tools.description: Show free space and the current date on the phone.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the phone screen and show it. Tries Termux:API, then Android's built-in screencap. Only works if the assistant can see images (DeepSeek Vision model).
run: out="$ZS_WORKSPACE/.zs-screenshot.png"; rm -f "$out"; if command -v termux-screenshot >/dev/null 2>&1; then   termux-screenshot "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ ! -s "$out" ] && command -v screencap >/dev/null 2>&1; then   screencap -p "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ ! -s "$out" ]; then   echo "Could not capture the screen. Android blocks screenshots from a plain shell unless Termux:API is installed (Termux:API app from F-Droid + 'pkg install termux-api'), or the device is rooted. If you already have a screenshot saved, use show_image with its path instead." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "screen captured"

tools.name: show_image
tools.description: Show an image file that already exists on the phone (png/jpg), so the assistant can look at it. Give the path, e.g. screenshot.png. Requires a model that can see images (DeepSeek Vision).

path.description: image file, relative to the workspace

run: f="$1"; case "$f" in /*) : ;; *) f="$ZS_WORKSPACE/$f" ;; esac; [ -s "$f" ] || { echo "No such image: $f" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "showing $f"

tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Generate a 3D model (cube, sphere, house) and save as OBJ.

tools.name: run_shell
tools.description: Run a shell command in the workspace.

tools.name: update_zeroscript
tools.description: Update the ZeroScript-Free repository (git pull) and show the latest commit.

tools.name: railway_login
tools.description: Begin a Railway login. Returns a pairing code and URL for the user to open in a browser; it does NOT wait. After the user confirms, call railway_login_status.

tools.name: railway_login_status
tools.description: Check whether the Railway login has completed. Reports the account name only, never a token.

tools.name: railway_login_cancel
tools.description: Abandon a pending Railway login.

tools.name: railway_whoami
tools.description: Show which Railway account is currently authenticated.

tools.name: railway_status
tools.description: Show the linked Railway project and its services.

tools.name: railway_list
tools.description: List the Railway projects on this account.

tools.name: railway_logs
tools.description: Show recent deployment logs for the linked service.

tools.name: railway_variables
tools.description: List the environment variables of the linked service. Values are shown, so avoid this if secrets are set.

tools.name: railway_up
tools.description: Deploy the current workspace folder to Railway. Confirm with the user before using this.
